justification: Plain-English fixes (frontend display): (1) when a satellite layer is empty despite satellite being requested, say 'We couldn't complete this analysis — try again', not 'no structures detected' (which falsely implies a finding on a built lot) or 'tick the box'; (2) the heritage sentence no longer doubles 'Heritage Conservation Area — Heritage Conservation Area' — it renders the hca/items strings (which carry the instrument) cleanly.

pre_impl.existing_data: describeUnavailable returned a satellite 'No result' message mentioning 'no structures detected'; humanizeHeritage prefixed 'In a Heritage Conservation Area — ' onto v.hca which itself already starts with 'Heritage Conservation Area (instrument)'.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Backend investigation: GF empty is almost always a failed scan (its structure detection needs a Modal GPU endpoint, MODAL_STRUCTURES_URL, that is undocumented and likely unset on Railway), NOT a real 'no structures' finding — so the old wording stated a false fact.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data or function. Reworded one branch of describeUnavailable and simplified humanizeHeritage to avoid the doubled prefix.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'No result — no structures detected' (false) and 'Heritage Conservation Area — Heritage Conservation Area (...)'. After: 'We couldn't complete this analysis — try again' and 'This property is heritage-affected: Heritage Conservation Area (Inner West LEP 2022); Heritage Item (...).'

functions.name: humanizeHeritage
functions.input: the heritage_postgis dict with has_heritage, hca and items keys
functions.output: one plain sentence citing the conservation area and/or heritage item, or a 'no listing' line
functions.if_none: returns 'No heritage listing recorded at this property.' when has_heritage is falsy

values: N/A - no regulatory values; display strings only. The heritage instrument names come from the data, not hardcoded.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: A satellite layer is genuinely unavailable for the area (not a failure)
break_it.what_happens: the message must not falsely claim a finding either way
break_it.repro: the reworded message says 'couldn't complete — may be temporarily unavailable', which is true whether it failed or has no coverage
break_it.how: the wording avoids asserting a specific finding like 'no structures'

break_it.scenario: heritage v.hca is present but v.items is absent
break_it.repro: parts only pushes present values and joins with '; '
break_it.how: join over a filtered parts array yields no trailing separator

break_it.what_happens: showing a heritage sentence would be wrong
break_it.repro: the function returns the 'No heritage listing' line when has_heritage is falsy

post_merge.other_repo: BACKEND ACTION (not in this PR): Granny Flat structure detection needs MODAL_STRUCTURES_URL set on the Railway backend; terrain needs the whitebox-tools binary installed; flood detail (JRC/WOfS) needs Planetary Computer access. Until those are configured, these layers correctly show 'couldn't complete'. Product decision: configure them or stop listing them.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite on: an empty satellite layer reads 'We couldn't complete this analysis — try again'; the heritage line reads as one clean sentence with the instrument, no 'Raw: 2 items' and no doubled prefix.
